response.sql: WITH rates AS (SELECT m.Name AS Name, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS rate FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.Name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate FROM rates) SELECT r.Name AS MediaTypeName, r.rate AS ByteRate, r.rate - o.avg_rate AS DifferenceAboveAverage FROM rates r CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE r.rate > o.avg_rate ORDER BY r.rate DESC
